lead: Nitish Kumar is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 1 March 1951 in Bakhtiarpur.
As of 2026, he is 75 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Bihar and member of a Legislative Assembly of India and has been recognised with the CNN-News18 Indian of the Year.
This profile collects the Nitish facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Nitish Kumar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Nitish Kumar was born on 1 March 1951 in Bakhtiarpur, and holds Indian nationality.
He received his education at National Institute of Technology, Patna.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi, English, Bhojpuri and Maithili.

sections.heading: Nitish Kumar — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Bihar (2015–2026), member of a Legislative Assembly of India, Chief Minister of Bihar (2005–2014), Member of the 11th Lok Sabha, Member of the 12th Lok Sabha and Member of the 13th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Janata Dal (United).
